title: Alpine Client Options
doc: Client look options; Alpine loads every af_client_*.tbl it finds, and af_client.tbl when a mod is loaded.

alpine.notes: Alpine reads this file line by line, not with the game's table parser: lines are trimmed, everything before a line that is exactly #Start is ignored, reading stops at a line that is exactly #End, blank lines and lines starting with // are skipped, and every other line is 'name: value' split at the first colon. Field order does not matter, a later line overrides an earlier one, and unknown names are only logged. Comments after a value become part of the value.

sections.name: #Start
sections.doc: Options between #Start and #End, in any order.

fields.name: $Assault Rifle Ammo Counter Color:
fields.doc: Colour of the assault rifle ammunition digits. Colour as hex RRGGBB or RRGGBBAA, or r, g, b (optionally in { } or < >), quotes optional.

fields.name: $Precision Rifle Scope Color:
fields.doc: Precision rifle scope tint. Colour as hex RRGGBB or RRGGBBAA, or r, g, b (optionally in { } or < >), quotes optional.

fields.name: $Sniper Rifle Scope Color:
fields.doc: Sniper rifle scope tint. Colour as hex RRGGBB or RRGGBBAA, or r, g, b (optionally in { } or < >), quotes optional.

fields.name: $Rail Driver Fire Glow Color:

fields.name: $Rail Driver Fire Flash Color:

fields.name: $Multi Timer X Offset:
fields.doc: Horizontal offset of the multiplayer timer.

fields.name: $Multi Timer Y Offset:
fields.doc: Vertical offset of the multiplayer timer.

fields.doc: Colour of the multiplayer timer. Colour as hex RRGGBB or RRGGBBAA, or r, g, b (optionally in { } or < >), quotes optional.
